summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Section 30 notification under the Danish Capital Markets Act that Oaktree Capital Group Holdings GP, LLC has informed the company that OCM Njord Holdings S. r.l. holds 20,329,874 shares, representing 19.86% of total share capital and voting rights. This is a routine major shareholder disclosure, not a special situation. No actionable corporate event, transaction, or board action is triggered. The filing serves as a regulatory transparency notice, similar to a Schedule 13D/13G amendment but without any activist intent or change of control implications. What to watch: any subsequent filings if Oaktree increases its stake or proposes changes.
